seed: A recording opened the way the Finder opens one, at Next defaults with no flag set, shows its first frame sharp without the playhead being moved. It used to open on a frame read before the canvas had fitted its window, an eighth of the size, stretched up and blurred until the playhead moved.

steps.note: THE TEST: the recording just opened, playhead at 0:00 and never moved, and the frame on screen is read at the size the canvas shows it
a second later, still nothing pressed, and nothing has swapped a smaller read back in
